paragraph: Angola's planning office says [the data for its 2022/2023 statistical yearbook were collected through SIGE](<https://www.ine.gov.ao/publicacoes/detalhes/MzgzMzA%3D>). It calls the platform in operation but not a finished product. [ADEA says the ministry is discussing an EMIS legal framework and a modernised national EMIS](<https://adeanet.org/en/news/angola-embarks-journey-transform-education-data-systems>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the Angolan firm Mwango Brain took on the technical work of that project with the planning office](<https://revistaoutside.com/2026/08/05/empresa-angolana-assume-implementacao-tecnica-do-sistema-de-dados-da-educacao/>). No source found since October 2023 says SIGE holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

Under a December 2022 agreement with UNESCO, Burundi's education ministry [built a human-resources module for the SIGE](<https://www.jobrapide.org/offres/avis-recrutement/lunesco-recherche-une-consultante-internationale-sige-burundi/>), UNESCO said in December 2024. A workshop in mid-2024 [planned the module's link to the STATEDUC statistics tool](<https://mesrs.gov.bi/atelier-dappropriation-et-de-revue-de-la-planification-des-activites-du-projet-dappui-a-loperationnalisation-du-module-de-gestion-des-ressources-humaines-du-sige-burundi/>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026 UNESCO [trained seven ministry staff in database administration](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/renforcement-du-sige-au-burundi-des-cadres-du-menrs-en-formation-yaounde>). In June 2026 an African Union Commission workshop in Bujumbura [set out to strengthen the system](<https://www.continental-infos.com/flash-infos/bujumbura-burundi-from-strategy-to-systems-au-iped-supports-burundis-next-step-in-strengthening-education-data/>). No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through it. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[In August 2026 the EducMaster portal of Benin's education ministries said the SIGE produces statistical reports and national indicators by department](<https://educmaster.bj/>). [The platform lists 1,804,826 learners, 63,305 teachers and 17,330 schools](<https://educmaster.bj/>). This position dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found to compare it with. No source found since October 2023 says the system holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[In September 2024 IIEP said it had helped integrate education-in-emergencies data into Burkina Faso's SIGE](<https://www.iiep.unesco.org/fr/articles/proteger-leducation-contre-les-attaques-les-donnees-esu-au-burkina-faso>). [This let the education ministry update the annual school census results and report school reopenings to central government](<https://www.iiep.unesco.org/fr/articles/proteger-leducation-contre-les-attaques-les-donnees-esu-au-burkina-faso>). [The director general of education studies and statistics, Sylvain Ouédraogo, said the SIGE is being renovated](<https://faso7.com/2024/12/30/burkina-faso-les-journees-des-statistiques-de-leducation-nationale-et-de-lalphabetisation-jsena-pour-reflechir-a-la-production-de-statistiques-adaptees-aux-besoins/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether an education information system is under way or in service in Botswana. No source has been found since that date that names a national education management information system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need the education ministry to procure, pilot or build an education management information system.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether an education information system is under way or in service in the Central African Republic. No source has been found since that date that names a national education management information system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need the education ministry to procure, pilot or build an education management information system.

[Fraternité Matin reports the education minister launched the SIGE on 10 July 2025, funded by the MCC](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2635269/societe/education-digitale-mariatou-kone-lance-un-outil-revolutionnaire-pour-une-ecole-plus-performante>). [It was tested in Bouaké and San Pedro and is to be extended nationwide when financing allows](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2635269/societe/education-digitale-mariatou-kone-lance-un-outil-revolutionnaire-pour-une-ecole-plus-performante>). [Ecofin Agency reports that since 2022 the Education Ministry has deployed an Integrated Education Management Information System (SIGE) with MCC support under a $536 million Compact](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-services/2508-58296-cote-d-ivoire-turns-to-digital-mapping-to-improve-school-planning>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[In June 2024 the National Institute of Statistics published the first education and training sector yearbook, for 2021-2022](<https://ins-cameroun.cm/en/statistique/statistical-yearbook-of-the-education-and-training-sector-in-cameroon-2021-2022/>). It pointed users to the online EMIS platform for more detailed data. [On 8 May 2025 the basic education ministry presented the integrated sectoral SIGE platform](<https://www.parec-cameroun.net/presentation-officielle-de-la-plateforme-sectorielle-integree-du-sige-et-des-documents-et-outils-conceptuels-et-methodologie/>), which is designed to hold the statistics of every education and training subsector. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the platform holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[In June 2023 a World Bank paper said DIGE had collected 2022/23 school data through the e-SIGE-DRC application](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121724060523706/txt/P172341-54806169-ac97-4144-8f26-c20d06662f3c.txt>). [That collection covered the 10 project provinces](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121724060523706/txt/P172341-54806169-ac97-4144-8f26-c20d06662f3c.txt>). In the last twelve months, [the African Union Commission says a workshop in Kinshasa on 12-14 May 2026 supports the DRC in assessing and strengthening its Education Management Information System](<http://www.au.int/en/pressreleases/20260512/au-iped-supports-education-data-systems-self-assessment-drc>). No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

In December 2025 the World Bank's TRESOR project [recorded no integrated EMIS in Congo](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121925064520650/pdf/P179410-b8959451-e7dc-4e80-8fd1-c81ec062a66f.pdf>), with one targeted by July 2030. In the last twelve months, in May 2026 an African Union workshop in Brazzaville [reviewed the state of the country's EMIS](<http://www.au.int/en/pressreleases/20260519/congo-moves-modernize-education-data-systems-au-iped>). In August 2026 the state IT agency ACSI [presented its integrated education management project, the SIGE](<https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202608110263.html>), to the National Assembly's Ecofin committee. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through a system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

Comoros runs a national education platform, e-Msomo, built by the education ministry with the digital agency ANADEN and UNICEF. In December 2025 UNICEF said it [held over 80,000 pupils, 700 schools and 3,000 teachers](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/unicef-comores_anaden-scolaires-%C3%A9l%C3%A8ves-activity-7411757191952580608-VR1Z>) in one national database, and that it follows each pupil's school path, attendance and marks. Schools are still being added. An earlier AFD project, run from 2019, [listed deploying the SIGE information system](<https://www.afd.fr/fr/projets/projet-de-performance-et-gouvernance-de-leducation-aux-comores-pgec>) among its aims. In the last twelve months, UNICEF's account of December 2025 is the latest position found. No source found since October 2023 says every school's pupils have records in the system. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[In March 2025 the national education directorate said SIGE was in use in basic and secondary schools](<https://www.asemana.cv/index.php/atualidade/14072-implementacao-do-sige-e-passo-fundamental-para-eficiencia-da-gestao-educativa-no-pais-dne>). [In July 2025 the directorate began national training on a new special-needs module in SIGE](<https://www.governo.cv/direcao-nacional-da-educacao-realiza-acao-formativa-no-novo-modulo-de-criancas-com-necessidades-educativas-especiais-no-sige/>). In the last twelve months, [in April 2026 the GPE approved a US$1 million grant for PRISE 2026-2028](<https://www.governo.cv/parceria-global-para-educacao-aprova-subvencao-nao-reembolsavel-de-um-milhao-de-dolares-ao-governo/>), whose work includes expanding and modernising SIGE. No source found since October 2023 says the school census or education statistics are produced through SIGE. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[In September 2025 La Nation reported a circular of the education minister dated 1 September 2025](<https://www.lanation.dj/une-rentree-scolaire-2025-2026-placee-sous-le-signe-de-la-performance-et-de-la-reforme/>). [It makes consolidating the Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE) a priority](<https://www.lanation.dj/une-rentree-scolaire-2025-2026-placee-sous-le-signe-de-la-performance-et-de-la-reforme/>). [The work runs through the GOSE and SMIS platforms, to produce reliable, regularly updated data](<https://www.lanation.dj/une-rentree-scolaire-2025-2026-placee-sous-le-signe-de-la-performance-et-de-la-reforme/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[In November 2024 the education ministry said an updated 2025 version of the national education sector information system was being prepared](<https://elwatan.dz/numerisation-dans-le-secteur-de-leducation-lancement-des-demain-dun-vaste-processus-devaluation/>). [It was to be ready in March 2025, after a nationwide evaluation](<https://elwatan.dz/numerisation-dans-le-secteur-de-leducation-lancement-des-demain-dun-vaste-processus-devaluation/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months, and no source found since October 2023 says the 2025 version was issued. No source found since that date says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[The ministry says its central database is the source of the 2024/25 statistical yearbook](<https://emis.gov.eg/statistics/books/2024-2025/main_book2024.html>). It holds every element of the education process. [In June 2025 the ministry took kindergarten and grade 1 applications for public schools online through its EMIS portal](<https://moe.gov.eg/what-s-on/news/regis/>). [A 2025 book chapter says the ministry's Digital Identity Project stores data on each student in central databases](<https://books.openbookpublishers.com/10.11647/obp.0489/ch23.xhtml>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found names a unique learner number in national service. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[On 19 April 2024 Eritrea's Ministry of Education submitted a programme document to GPE](<https://www.globalpartnership.org/node/document/download?file=document%2Ffile%2F2024-04-eritrea-gpe-grant-program-document.pdf>). [It seeks US$14.02m, through UNICEF](<https://www.globalpartnership.org/node/document/download?file=document%2Ffile%2F2024-04-eritrea-gpe-grant-program-document.pdf>). [The funds include strengthened routine data collection, processing, storage and use in the national EMIS](<https://www.globalpartnership.org/node/document/download?file=document%2Ffile%2F2024-04-eritrea-gpe-grant-program-document.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[The Ministry of Education's EMIS and ICT Executive Office published the Education Statistics Annual Abstract 2022/2023 in October 2023](<https://moe.gov.et/storage/Books/ESAA%202022-23%20Final.pdf>). [The office says the EMIS is available at decentralised levels and collects education performance data](<https://moe.gov.et/storage/Books/ESAA%202022-23%20Final.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026 the education minister said [the EMIS and its higher-education counterpart were being strengthened](<https://web.archive.org/web/20261002215440/https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_9638343>). He said this would connect data on students, teachers, institutions and outcomes. No source found since October 2023 says the system holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

In August 2025 the education ministry [began adding school health indicators to its education management information system, the SIGE](<https://gabonmediatime.com/gabon-integration-de-la-sante-scolaire-dans-le-systeme-de-gestion-educative>). In October 2024 SOSUP [launched a national operation to identify schools and give each learner a unique national identifier](<https://lejournaldeslycees.ga/2024/10/19/operation-nationale-didentification-des-etablissements-et-des-apprenants/>). Provincial and zonal delegates collect the school and pupil files for it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. The census of 2021 is not tied to it. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[The Ministry of Education completed a review of Education Management Information System indicators at a 17-18 December 2025 workshop](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/education-ministry-updates-emis-indicators-to-strengthen-ict-integration-in-schools/>). [Stakeholders agreed to integrate the revised indicators into the next national school census](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/education-ministry-updates-emis-indicators-to-strengthen-ict-integration-in-schools/>). This review dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier set of indicators has been found to compare it with. [The Ministry of Education's PMDV Dashboard API documentation lists an EMIS schools statistics endpoint](<https://pmdv.moedatadashboard.com/api_documentation>). No source found since October 2023 says the system holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

In December 2023 [a World Bank report said work to strengthen the ministry's EMIS under a UNESCO contract was delayed](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122123075517241/txt/P1674781dab5d60fb1b3b41a1e5a3eb4e1d.txt>). Since 2024 the education ministry, through its examinations directorate DGECS, has run [a platform on which schools enrol their pupils](<https://educationactu.com/11224-2/>), Educationactu reported in October 2026. In 2024-25 it covered grades 7 and 11. In the last twelve months, in 2025-26 it was extended to the intermediate classes of primary and secondary school, except grade 9. No source found since October 2023 says the education information system produced an annual school census. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[The Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education began building its education information system on DHIS2 in 2018](<https://education.dhis2.org/the-gambia-launches-online-education-data-centre/>). [In August 2025 DHIS2 said the ministry's digital student registry gives each learner a unique ID](<https://education.dhis2.org/gambia-modernizing-education-data-kix-knowledge-cafe/>). It holds nearly 80% of Gambian learners. In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the ministry opened the Education Data Center to the public](<https://education.dhis2.org/the-gambia-launches-online-education-data-centre/>). It brings the school census, attendance reports and other sources into one portal. No source found since October 2023 says learner records are linked to the national ID or another government system. Mature would need learner records linked to the national ID, or data exchanged with another government system.

[In October 2025 FEC said practical training began on the SIGE 2.0 education information and management platform](<https://www.fecongd.org/2025/10/20/projeto-peside-quer-estatisticas-de-qualidade-para-a-educacao-na-guine-bissau/>). [The EU-funded PESIDE project runs it with the Ministry of Education](<https://www.fecongd.org/2025/10/20/projeto-peside-quer-estatisticas-de-qualidade-para-a-educacao-na-guine-bissau/>). In the last twelve months, [in February 2026 a Global Partnership for Education blog said PESIDE aims to strengthen the Education Management Information System (EMIS)](<https://www.globalpartnership.org/blog/better-data-improve-education-guinea-bissau>). No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[In September 2025 the government moved from NEMIS to KEMIS, the Daily Nation reports](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/education/education-data-systems-switch-schools-millions-in-funding-gaps-5633286>). [A Ministry of Education KEMIS Secretariat circular says KEMIS holds learner records](<https://arena.co.ke/ministry-circular-guidance-on-learner-validation-in-kemis/>). [KEMIS generates a Unique Learner Identifier (ULI) for learners in schools](<https://arena.co.ke/ministry-circular-guidance-on-learner-validation-in-kemis/>). In the last twelve months, [KEMIS was the required platform for the 2026 Grade 10 selection](<https://techweez.com/2026/09/09/the-nemis-to-kemis-dilemma/>). [By 10 November 2026 it held about 5.06 million primary learners of 7.2 million expected](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/education/ghost-students-puzzle-of-2-million-primary-school-learners-missing-from-ministry-records-5667184>). No source found since October 2023 says learner records are linked to the national ID or another government system. Mature would need learner records linked to the national ID, or data exchanged with another government system.

[The ministry's EMIS portal shows academic year 2024-25 census data for all 15 counties](<https://www.emis-moe-lib.org/>). [It lists 1,274,610 enrolled students in 6,394 registered schools](<https://www.emis-moe-lib.org/>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the education ministry said regular Annual School Census collection had resumed](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/news/moe-pushes-for-real-time-school-data-system/article_8b8f6a05-6bcd-4adb-9460-d004f8f07b16.html>), after an interruption following 2021. [The EMIS portal says it tracks every enrolled learner with a unique identifier](<https://www.emis-moe-lib.org/>), but in September 2026 the ministry was still seeking a digitised EMIS. No source settles whether a record for each learner is in service. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[In July 2024 the Ministry of Education, supported by UNICEF Libya, launched its Education Management Information System (EMIS)](<https://libyaobserver.ly/education/education-ministry-launches-emis-cooperation-unicef>). [Al-Wasat named the system OpenEMIS](<https://alwasat.ly/news/libya/446510>). [The launch followed a pilot in 205 educational institutions](<https://libyaobserver.ly/education/education-ministry-launches-emis-cooperation-unicef>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

Lesotho's national education information system is LEMIS. [In May 2026 the ministry said LEMIS was still being built](<https://education.dhis2.org/building-a-smarter-education-data-system-in-lesotho-with-dhis2/>). It is meant to cover 4,819 institutions and was not yet live for nationwide collection. In the last twelve months, in October 2026 [an AU-IPED brief said Lesotho had adopted DHIS2 for Education](<https://www.iped.africa/news-event/from-data-entry-to-data-leadership-lessons-from-lesothos-dhis2-for-education-training>) as the platform for LEMIS. [All 365 secondary schools report through it, the brief said](<https://www.iped.africa/news-event/from-data-entry-to-data-leadership-lessons-from-lesothos-dhis2-for-education-training>). No source found since October 2023 says the school census or national statistics were produced through it. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[The ministry ran the 2025-2026 annual school census from 20 October to 20 November 2025](<https://fr.expresstv.ma/2025/10/le-ministere-de-leducation-nationale-lance-le-recensement-scolaire-annuel-pour-lannee-scolaire-2025-2026/>), and a ministry letter named Massar as the main source of its statistics. A 2024 ministry circular says Massar [digitises each pupil's school file and gives each pupil a digital identifier](<https://ar.hibapress.com/details-517593.html>), and that its enrolment services [rely on digital identity and can download data from the civil status register](<https://ar.hibapress.com/details-517593.html>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says how many pupils hold the digital identifier. None counts the records drawn from the civil status register.

[Madagascar's authorities launched at a 15-17 July 2024 workshop in Toamasina the digitisation of schools, starting in Atsinanana](<https://www.wearetech.africa/actualites/fils/actualites/gestion-publique/madagascar-met-ses-ecoles-au-numerique>), covering data collection and a pupil register. [A financing law for the TALIM programme, adopted by the Senate in 2025, provides for modernising the education management information system](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/gestion-publique/du-contenu-a-la-gestion-madagascar-accelere-la-numerisation-de-son-systeme-educatif>). [In April 2023 INSTAT said the planning directorate collected the 2022-2023 school census and entered it in ministry software](<https://instat.mg/p/men-annuaire-statistique-de-leducation-2022-2023>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the school census is run through the system. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[In October 2024 UNESCO said the education ministry's planning unit (CPS) collected 2023-24 national data on school-health indicators integrated into the SIGE](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/lunesco-appuie-la-production-des-statistiques-liees-la-sante-du-systeme-dinformation-et-de-gestion>). In the last twelve months, [in March 2026 UNESCO said the SIGE holds national data, collected regularly by the ministry](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/lunesco-appuie-le-ministere-de-leducation-nationale-pour-la-production-des-statistiques-en-sante>). [A March 2026 workshop analysed its data for the 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 school years](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/lunesco-appuie-le-ministere-de-leducation-nationale-pour-la-production-des-statistiques-en-sante>). No source found since October 2023 says the system holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[The education ministry's Planning and Cooperation Directorate runs the annual 3 March school census (Levantamento Escolar 2024, public and private schools)](<https://mozdata.ine.gov.mz/index.php/catalog/119>). [Its Statistics Department publishes the resulting education statistics brochure each year](<https://mozdata.ine.gov.mz/index.php/catalog/119>). In the last twelve months, [an assessment on 3-4 August 2026, supported by GPE KIX, found an established EMIS with several data subsystems and electronic platforms](<https://www.gpekix.org/news/mozambique-sets-priorities-stronger-education-data-system>). [It found that education statistics already inform teacher deployment and resource allocation](<https://www.gpekix.org/news/mozambique-sets-priorities-stronger-education-data-system>). No source found since October 2023 says the system holds a record for each learner. Operating would need the system to hold individual learner records with a unique learner number, in service for schools across the country.

[A UNESCO IITE project with Chengdu Group, completed in 2025, piloted an education management information system for secondary schools](<https://iite.unesco.org/news/unesco-iite-and-chengdu-group-complete-project-on-inclusive-digital-education-in-mauritius-and-rwanda/>). The pilot is the only education information system on record for the country. Nothing found says the ministry runs its school census through a national system. Nothing found says it publishes its education statistics from one either. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Establishing would need the ministry to collect or publish an annual school census or education statistics through its education information system.

[The ministry's Education Statistics Report 2023/24 comes from the Annual School Census, run through the EMIS](<https://cms.nsomalawi.mw/api/download/400/ASC-Report-2024.pdf>). It counts 5,420,159 primary pupils and 538,800 secondary students. In the last twelve months, in May 2026 [a policy brief said pupils get Learner Identification Numbers on entry to school](<https://www.gpekix.org/sites/default/files/2026-07/Saddick%20et%20al.%20-%202026%20-%20From%20Data%20Collection%20to%20Data%20Use%20Strengthening%20decision-making%20at%20subnational%20levels%20in%20Malawi.pdf>), and that cohort tracking within the EMIS generates longitudinal learner-level data. No source found since October 2023 says learner records are linked to the national ID or another government system. Mature would need learner records linked to the national ID or birth registration number, or exchanging data with another government system.

[In 2024 the Ministry of Education, Arts and Culture said its EMIS division collects data from all state and private schools twice a year](<https://www.moe.gov.na/index.php/dep/dep-fa/dir-pad/emis>). [It publishes the Fifteenth School Day Report and the Annual Education Census](<https://www.moe.gov.na/index.php/dep/dep-fa/dir-pad/emis>). [The ministry lists census reports for 2019 to 2023](<https://www.moe.gov.na/index.php/dep/dep-fa/dir-pad/emis>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.
